ce_bugs.text: app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:15 — The public GET enqueues work before validating the embed URL host, so forged requests can flood Sidekiq with cheap jobs.
lib/topic_retriever.rb:27 — The throttle is committed before retrieval succeeds, causing a retry after a transient failure to no-op and be reported as successful.
app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:35 — One malformed feed item aborts the loop while retries are disabled, permanently starving every later item until the bad entry is removed.
app/models/topic_embed.rb:22 — Feed-controlled markup is stored as raw HTML without sanitization, allowing a compromised feed to persist script-capable content on the Discourse origin.
app/models/topic_embed.rb:15 — Concurrent imports use a check-then-create sequence, so the unique-index collision aborts one import and can terminate the remainder of its feed batch.
app/models/topic_embed.rb:11 — The protocol-prefix regex accepts hostless URLs such as http://, allowing permanently invalid embed records to be created.
app/models/topic_embed.rb:37 — The content hash is advanced even when PostRevisor declines or fails to persist the revision, preventing later polls from retrying the missed update.
app/models/topic_embed.rb:64 — Document-relative links and images are left unresolved, so imported content points at the Discourse embed URL instead of the source article.
lib/topic_retriever.rb:15 — Host-only validation accepts unsupported schemes such as ftp for the configured host, causing fetches that TopicEmbed.import can never store.

db/migrate/20131219203905_add_cook_method_to_posts.rb:3 — The default value 1 backfills every existing post as raw_html even though regular is enum value 0, silently reclassifying user content and bypassing normal cooking.

db/migrate/20131217174004_create_topic_embeds.rb:3 — force: true drops any pre-existing topic_embeds table before creation, so running this migration against schema drift irreversibly deletes embed mappings.

db/migrate/20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb:3 — Adding force: true makes this migration drop any pre-existing top_topics table before creation, destroying ranking data that rollback cannot restore.
app/models/topic_embed.rb:13 — import` mutates its caller-owned contents string, creating a hidden boundary side effect that can accumulate attribution markup when the value is reused.
app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:15 — Every cache miss enqueues a job before the per-URL throttle, so reloads or request bursts can grow the Sidekiq queue without bound.
lib/topic_retriever.rb:41 — Each distinct missing URL synchronously repolls and reimports the entire feed, multiplying network, parsing, and database work by the feed size.
app/models/topic_embed.rb:48 — Reading an unbounded remote response fully into memory before parsing lets a large page exhaust a worker's memory.
app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:29 — Feed polling materializes the complete unbounded response and processes every item without a cap, allowing a large feed to monopolize worker memory and time.

mrv_findings.text: app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb:4 — P1 confidence 75 — "<%= stylesheet_link_tag 'embed' %>" — The new standalone stylesheet is never added to the asset precompile list, so production rendering can fail with an asset-not-precompiled error.

app/models/topic_embed.rb:48 — P1 confidence 75 — "doc = Readability::Document.new(open(url).read," — This execution path never requires `open-uri` and instead depends on the unrelated poll-feed job loading first; otherwise `open(url)` treats the HTTP URL as a local filename and retrieval fails.

app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:35 — P1 confidence 75 — "content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)" — `String#scrub` is unavailable on the Ruby 2.0 runtime this codebase supports, so feed polling raises `NoMethodError` before importing any item.

app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:35 — P1 confidence 100 — "content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)" — Standard RSS items may provide `description` but no `content`, so one valid item raises on `nil.scrub` and prevents the feed from importing.

app/models/topic_embed.rb:64 — P1 confidence 100 — "if href.present? && href.start_with?('/')" — The promised relative-URL conversion omits path-relative references such as `images/a.png` and misinterprets protocol-relative URLs such as `//cdn.example/a.png`, leaving imported links and images broken.

app/models/topic_embed.rb:11 — P1 confidence 75 — "return unless url =~ /^https?\:\/\//" — Prefix matching is not complete URL validation, so malformed HTTP-looking values such as `http://` pass this guard and can be persisted or fail later during URI processing.

app/models/topic_embed.rb:34 — P2 confidence 100 — "if content_sha1 != embed.content_sha1" — Re-import only revises body content, so a feed entry title change never updates the already-created topic despite the feed job claiming to update topics.

app/views/embed/loading.html.erb:9 — P2 confidence 100 — "document.location.reload();" — Retrieval has no terminal error or timeout state, so missing users, fetch failures, and parse failures leave visitors reloading the loading iframe forever.

app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:10 — P2 confidence 100 — "class PollFeed < Jobs::Scheduled" — An hourly RSS/Atom ingestion subsystem is an independent product and operational feature not traceable to enhancing embed URL handling or validation.

lib/tasks/disqus.thor:148 — P2 confidence 75 — "post = TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])" — The change rewrites the existing Disqus XML import flow to fetch remote article content and drops its category behavior, expanding the task into an unrelated importer contract change.

app/models/post.rb:133 — P2 confidence 75 — "return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]" — Introducing a system-wide raw-HTML rendering mode expands the core post model beyond the stated embed URL handling and validation objective.

db/migrate/20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb:3 — P2 confidence 100 — "create_table :top_topics, force: true do |t|" — Altering creation semantics for the unrelated top-topics table has no traceability to embedding requirements and unnecessarily broadens the change’s database blast radius.

db/migrate/20131217174004_create_topic_embeds.rb:4 — P1 confidence 100 — "t.integer :topic_id, null: false; t.integer :post_id, null: false" — The model redundantly stores both topic and post identity without foreign keys or a constraint that the post belongs to that topic, so deletions or mismatches can make lookup display one topic while imports update another post.

app/models/topic_embed.rb:15 — P1 confidence 100 — "embed = TopicEmbed.where(embed_url: url).first" — This check-then-create flow races concurrent retrieval jobs; both can observe no row and the loser then raises on the unique embed_url index instead of idempotently returning the winner.

app/models/topic_embed.rb:22 — P1 confidence 75 — "skip_validations: true, cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]" — Feed-controlled records bypass every Post validation, allowing imported topics to violate application invariants that downstream post/topic code assumes.

app/models/topic_embed.rb:48 — P1 confidence 100 — "Readability::Document.new(open(url).read," — A user-triggered remote page is fully materialized with no size bound or timeout, so one slow or huge response can monopolize or exhaust a background worker.

lib/topic_retriever.rb:41 — P1 confidence 100 — "Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})" — Every cache miss synchronously runs the global feed poll before fetching its page, so concurrent misses for different URLs multiply full-feed downloads and per-item database work.

app/views/embed/loading.html.erb:9 — P1 confidence 100 — "document.location.reload();" — Retrieval has no persisted failed/terminal state, so configuration, parsing, or network failures leave the iframe reloading and re-enqueuing retrieval forever.

app/models/post.rb:133 — P2 confidence 75 — "return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]" — The early return silently bypasses the established after_post_cook plugin extension point for imported posts, breaking plugins whose post-processing contract previously covered every cooked post.

app/models/post.rb:133 — P1 confidence 100 — "return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]" — Attacker-controlled RSS/article HTML bypasses the cooking sanitizer and is rendered with `raw`, enabling persistent same-origin XSS and authenticated action theft.

app/models/topic_embed.rb:13 — P1 confidence 100 — "contents << "
#{I18n.t('embed.imported_from', link: "#{url}")}... "" — An attacker-controlled same-host URL is interpolated unescaped into stored raw HTML, so quotes in the URL can inject attributes such as event handlers.

app/models/topic_embed.rb:48 — P1 confidence 100 — "doc = Readability::Document.new(open(url).read," — The server fetches a user-selected URL after hostname-only validation, without pinning the resolved public IP or revalidating redirects, enabling DNS-rebinding or redirect-based SSRF into internal services.

app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:26 — P2 confidence 100 — "raise Discourse::InvalidAccess.new('invalid referer host') if URI(request.referer || '').host != SiteSetting.embeddable_host" — Treating the forgeable Referer header as access control lets arbitrary HTTP clients invoke the GET endpoint and enqueue retrieval jobs for unbounded attacker-chosen paths.

app/assets/javascripts/embed.js:17 — P3 confidence 75 — "if (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1) { return; }" — Substring matching accepts origins that are only prefixes of the trusted Discourse URL, allowing an untrusted frame or popup to forge resize messages and manipulate the embed UI.

spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:43 — P1 confidence 100 — `TopicRetriever.expects(:new).returns(retriever)` — The test expects a synchronous retriever that the controller no longer constructs because it now enqueues `Jobs::RetrieveTopic`, so the test fails while leaving the actual enqueue contract unverified.

spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:10 — P2 confidence 100 — `response.should_not be_success` — The test claims an exact 404 but accepts every non-2xx response, so redirects and unrelated server errors produce false confidence.

spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:16 — P2 confidence 100 — `response.should_not be_success` — The missing-host and missing-referer tests never assert `Discourse::InvalidAccess` or its response status, so unrelated failures satisfy the claimed access-control behavior.

spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb:35 — P1 confidence 100 — `poller.expects(:poll_feed).once` — Every poll-feed test replaces the new feed-fetch/parse/import implementation with a mock, so malformed feeds, fallback IDs, content decoding, and `TopicEmbed.import` behavior are wholly unexercised.

spec/components/topic_retriever_spec.rb:33 — P1 confidence 100 — `topic_retriever.expects(:perform_retrieve).once` — The suite mocks the retriever’s core path and its throttle result, leaving the new Redis throttle, existing-embed guard, feed fallback, user lookup, and remote import branches untested.

spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb:11 — P1 confidence 100 — `context '.import' do` — Tests cover only `.import`; the new `.import_remote` readability extraction and remote-document-to-topic path has no test despite being the primary fallback used by `TopicRetriever`.

spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb:41 — P2 confidence 75 — `post.cooked.should =~ /new contents/` — The update test checks only a substring and can pass without verifying that the existing embed was reused, its digest advanced, or a duplicate topic/embed was not created.

db/migrate/20131217174004_create_topic_embeds.rb:3 — P1 confidence 75 — "create_table :topic_embeds, force: true do |t|" — If `topic_embeds` already exists during migration, `force: true` drops it and silently destroys all existing embed mappings before recreating the table.

db/migrate/20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb:3 — P1 confidence 75 — "create_table :top_topics, force: true do |t|" — Reapplying this migration against an existing `top_topics` table drops all ranking data before recreating the table, with no backup or recovery path.

db/migrate/20131219203905_add_cook_method_to_posts.rb:3 — P1 confidence 75 — "add_column :posts, :cook_method, :integer, default: 1, null: false" — Adding a non-null column with a default in one operation rewrites and exclusively locks the hot `posts` table on the target PostgreSQL generation, creating an unbounded deploy-window outage instead of an expand/backfill/contract rollout.
